checks.detail: the exact candidate must remain pinned to the dependency family certified by this contract
GET and POST /authorize must remain registered
backend code redemption must remain registered
authorization and redemption responses must remain non-cacheable
authorization responses must retain no-referrer policy
authorization UI must retain its restrictive CSP
authorization-code TTL must default to 90 seconds
browser handoff must fail closed without client, encryption, and database configuration
redirect URI must be exact-match allowlisted
return path must be exact-match allowlisted
authorization must require a 43-character base64url S256 challenge
state must remain bounded opaque base64url
password sign-in must derive its endpoint from the configured issuer
hosted and explicit self-hosted issuer behavior must have regression tests
browser handoff must store encrypted tokens behind an opaque hashed code
browser redirect must contain exactly code and state, never provider tokens
backend redemption must authenticate the registered client secret
redemption must validate and derive the PKCE verifier challenge
single use, client, redirect, expiry, and PKCE checks must remain one atomic update
provider tokens may be decrypted only after successful atomic consume
registered browser-client JSON must reject unknown fields
client metadata must reference an environment secret instead of embedding one
backend client secret must retain its minimum entropy floor
redirect registration must reject unsafe URL forms
return paths must remain local to the product origin
password submission must enforce the Shared Auth origin
authorization form must bind an HTTP-only, SameSite, ten-minute CSRF cookie
host scope, secure behavior, and lifetime must have regression tests
successful authorization must remove the CSRF cookie immediately
cookie handling must not depend on a transitive time-module re-export
authorization form must submit S256 explicitly
redeem endpoint must require backend bearer authentication
provider tokens may appear only in the backend redemption response
token bundles must remain AES-256-GCM encrypted
nonce generation must use the current rand 0.10 API
every ciphertext must use a fresh 96-bit nonce
AES-GCM nonce construction must not use the deprecated generic-array slice API
ciphertext must authenticate the handoff context as AAD
plaintext authorization codes must not be stored
PKCE challenge derivation must remain SHA-256/base64url
client-secret comparison must use current HMAC KeyInit and constant-time verification
declarative schema must own the browser authorization-code table
authorization-code table must retain code_hash
authorization-code table must retain client_id
authorization-code table must retain redirect_uri
authorization-code table must retain return_path
authorization-code table must retain supabase_project
authorization-code table must retain code_challenge
authorization-code table must retain encrypted_tokens
authorization-code table must retain expires_at
authorization-code table must retain consumed_at
unconsumed codes must retain their expiry index
schema ownership must remain declarative and migration-controlled
Kubernetes ExternalSecret must project AUTH_BROWSER_CLIENTS
Kubernetes ExternalSecret must project AUTH_HANDOFF_ENCRYPTION_KEY
Kubernetes ExternalSecret must project AUTH_BROWSER_ZPKG_SECRET
Kubernetes ExternalSecret must project AUTH_DATABASE_URL
deployment source must reference rather than embed credentials

limitations: This report certifies exact source and the enumerated source/deployment contract assertions.
Runtime PostgreSQL, Redis, compilation, browser, Supabase, RDS, Kubernetes, and production traffic evidence must be supplied by the invoking workflow.
